description: Source code for a firmware utility tool that reads, writes, and manipulates firmware images, including extracting and merging root filesystem and kernel components, and fixing checksums.

methods.name: print_usage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the firmware utility.

methods.name: read_img
methods.description: Reads a firmware image file into memory, verifying size.

methods.name: write_img
methods.description: Writes a firmware image from memory to a file.

methods.name: write_rootfs
methods.description: Extracts and writes the root filesystem from the firmware image to a file.

methods.name: write_kernel
methods.description: Extracts and writes the kernel from the firmware image to a file.

methods.name: read_rootfs
methods.description: Reads a root filesystem image file and inserts it into the firmware image buffer.

methods.name: read_kernel
methods.description: Reads a kernel binary file and inserts it into the firmware image buffer.

methods.name: get_checksum
methods.description: Retrieves the checksum value stored in the firmware image.

methods.name: set_checksum
methods.description: Sets the checksum value in the firmware image.

methods.name: compute_checksum
methods.description: Calculates the checksum of the firmware image data.
